name: Customer / discovery call
description: Capture customer goals, current workflows, constraints, and agreed follow-ups.

sections.title: Customer context
sections.instruction: Summarize who described the current workflow and why they are exploring a change. Cite the supplied source tags

sections.title: Goals and pain points
sections.instruction: List each stated goal or pain point with the customer's example, impact, or measure of success when given. Cite the supplied source tag for each point

sections.title: Requirements and open questions
sections.instruction: Separate confirmed requirements, preferences, and unanswered questions. Preserve the customer's wording when it matters and cite the supplied source tags

sections.title: Next steps
sections.instruction: List only agreed follow-ups with owners and dates when stated. Copy the supplied source tag next to each step
sections.item_format: - Task in one sentence. Owner: name or Unassigned; Due: date or Not specified
